title: Chapter 569 - 569 Identity; Remarks!
content:
Chapter 569 - 569 Identity; Remarks!

Chapter 569 - 569 Identity; Remarks!

569 Identity; Remarks!

After Lin Fan sat down to rest, Xiao Bing finally came back to her senses.

She looked at the countless bullet comments asking about Lin Fan. She opened her mouth but did not dare to answer casually.

She had received orders from her superiors to not interview or reveal Lin Fan’s identity.

At this moment, Xiao Bing’s earpiece rang with the leader’s dull voice.

“You can tell everyone Lin Fan’s identity.”

The leaders all knew that Lin Fan did not like to be exposed in front of the cameras.

Therefore, the leaders had been trying their best to facilitate this.

However, Lin Fan’s appearance had already been exposed.

In fact, he would continue to appear in the live broadcast for a long time.

Since that was the case, there was no problem with revealing Lin Fan’s identity.

In addition, after it was made public, it might even increase the confidence of the masses. This was a good thing for society.

After Xiao Bing received authorization from the higher-ups, she stopped hesitating and said loudly, “Hua Nation’s hero is Professor Lin Fan!”

As soon as she said that, the entire live broadcast room instantly fell silent.

A moment later, there was a barrage of comments.

Irene: [F*ck!]

Ma Yizheng: [F*ck!]

Mid-Air Wilderness: [F*ck!]

Happiness: [F*ck!]

…

It was no wonder that the audience would react as such.

Lin Fan’s name was too famous.

He solved many unsolved math problems, invented the earthquake detection device, the human islet recovery drug, two types of super batteries, the carbon-based engraving machine, the gaming helmet, and other high-tech products…

Not long ago, he won four Nobel Prizes at the same time!

This made Lin Fan the greatest scholar in the world, the pride of all Hua people.

Now, everyone realized that Lin Fan was the only person from Hua Nation who had been chosen to enter the Otherworld.

How could they not be surprised and excited?

Ma Da: [God Lin Fan is the chosen one. We’re saved!]

Falling From the Sky: [That’s right! God Lin Fan is omnipotent. He can definitely prevent us from heading toward the apocalypse.]

Love, Love, Love: [That’s great!]

Eldest Princess: [Lin Fan, good luck! I’ll pray for you.]

Youth Is Gone: [Haha! I know why Hua Nation only has one representative! That’s because the person chosen is God Lin Fan! This trip to the Otherworld will definitely be a competition of wisdom. Hua Nation will definitely win!]

Servant: [The twists and turns, the twists and turns!]

…

As expected, after announcing Lin Fan’s information, many people’s moods improved. They were filled with hope for the future.

However, this hope did not last long.

It was because they saw… Lin Fan sitting down in the same spot.

Moreover, he sat there for several hours.

One in Ten Thousand: [What’s wrong with God Lin Fan?]

Song Ren: [I don’t know.]

Big Wind: [Xiao Bing, tell me what happened to God Lin Fan.]

Chaos: [Is God Lin Fan feeling unwell?]

Dragon: [Is he thinking about something?]

Xiao Bing opened her mouth and found a lame reason after a while.

“Maybe Professor Lin is a little unaccustomed to the new world. After all, he suddenly went from Earth to another world.”

Winter Melon Skin: [I see.]

Red Man: [I hope that God Lin Fan can get well soon. Pray for him.]

Rich: [Pray for God Lin Fan.]

…

Song Family: [There’s a blog post on God Lin Fan’s actions. I’m copying it here for everyone to read.]

Ai Jin: [Lin Fan is the greatest scholar in the world! This is his strength, but at the same time, it’s also his weakness.

[Because all scholars are firm and confident.

[They believe that they can create and change everything.

[However, a god that they can’t understand suddenly appeared one day.

[In fact, the god even brought them into another world.

[Thus, their confidence and their hearts instantly shattered like glass that had been hit hard.

[This can explain why Lin Fan didn’t report himself after he became the chosen one.

[At the same time, it can also explain why Lin Fan is just sitting there without moving at all.

[He has completely given up!

[Unfortunately, there’s only one person from Hua Nation who was chosen.

[Everyone, please cherish your last moments!]

Yellow Man: [I think that his analysis seems to make sense.]

Easy: [God Lin Fan, please stand up!]

Farewell: [God Lin Fan, don’t be dispirited!]

…

The hope that had risen in everyone’s hearts began to fall again after the blog post by Ai Jin appeared.

Sitting in front of the computer, Ai Jin looked at the increasing number of visits and comments. His grin almost reached his ears.

This was all money!

Therefore, he was ready to strike while the iron was hot, and his hands kept jumping on the keyboard.

Not long after, he posted another blog post.

Ai Jin: [I didn’t want to say too much because I already have a Nashland passport, so I’m no longer a citizen of Hua Nation.

[However, seeing that there are too many people who want me to continue speaking, I will say more.

[I want to tell you some practical problems.

[Actually, even if Lin Fan isn’t dispirited, it won’t be of much use.

[He’s a great scholar and inventor on Earth.

[However, all this is because Earth has a very good infrastructure, and he received the help of countless scholars.

[That’s why he was able to succeed.

[Right now, Lin Fan is in a foreign world, in the middle of the wilderness.

[There’s no basic equipment there, and no one to help him. His knowledge is useless.

[A ferocious beast or a venomous snake could take his life.

[Therefore, hot weapons are very important.

[But Lin Fan doesn’t seem to have any.

[In addition, I have a piece of very bad news to tell everyone.

[Just now, Hendry of the Eagle Country encountered a scorpion that was as tall as a man and looked like a monster.

[Fortunately, Hendry had grenades and machine guns, which allowed him to kill the scorpion. He then received a mysterious reward.

[Light shot out from the Eagle Country’s Void Gate, causing the seawater of the Eagle Country to fall. The country now has an additional large piece of land!

[In other words, there are not only ferocious beasts in the Otherworld, but ferocious beasts that are much more terrifying than those on Earth.

[At the same time, it also shows that the performance of the heroes in the Otherworld is based on martial strength!

[Under such circumstances, how could Lin Fan survive without firearms? How should he perform?]

After this blog post was published, the number of visitors to Ai Jin’s post skyrocketed again. Countless comments appeared like raindrops.

At the same time, the number of Ai Jin’s followers also began to increase at a speed visible to the naked eye.

He laughed his head off.
